summary: The RptMnuNextAssignmentReport is a user control component designed to generate and manage the 'Next Assignment Report' within a web application. It utilizes user session data to fetch and display relevant report details and options. The component facilitates interaction with various UI elements and backend data procedures to generate report outputs in HTML and CSV formats.
purpose: The main purpose of the RptMnuNextAssignmentReport is to provide users with a detailed view and export of upcoming assignments through a specialized report. It allows users to define report parameters, run reports, and download outputs as CSV files.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Input field for entering the start date of the report period.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Input field for entering the end date of the report period.

fields.name: ltlDescription
fields.description: Displays the description of the report.

fields.name: ltlOptions
fields.description: Displays additional notes or options for the report.

fields.name: pnlReportHTML
fields.description: Panel to display the report in HTML format when generated.

fields.name: lblReportHTML
fields.description: Label to hold and display the generated report's HTML content.

workflows.name: Generate Report
steps: User sets start and end date using txtStartDate and txtEndDate fields.
User clicks cmdRunExcel to initiate report generation.
System executes a database procedure to fetch report data.
System generates report output in CSV format.
System displays the report in pnlReportHTML if successful.

business_rules: The report can only be generated if both start and end dates are provided.
A list of receiving agencies must be selected before running the report.

validations.description: Ensures the start date is in the correct format.
Ensures the end date is in the correct format.
Ensures the start date is provided.
Ensures the end date is provided.

conditions: If the report generation is initiated during an asynchronous postback, the JavaScript variables are registered using ScriptManager.
system_behavior: The system registers JavaScript variables related to input field IDs during pre-render.
If the report generation procedure returns data, the system outputs the report in CSV format and displays it in the HTML panel.
dependencies: Database stored procedures for report data retrieval.
JavaScript functions for client-side scripting and interaction.
exceptions: If SQL data reader returns no data, the report is not generated.
content_gaps: Detailed error handling behaviors are not fully described.
